dashboard_recap.article:
**MLB Recap: August 3rd**

A dominating day of baseball saw several standout performances across the league. In the Philadelphia Phillies' 8-0 win over the Baltimore Orioles, Bryce Harper, Alec Bohm, and Bryan De La Cruz all contributed with big hits. De La Cruz led the Phillies with a home run and three RBIs, while Zack Wheeler pitched two scoreless innings with three strikeouts. 

On the pitching side, several starters turned in impressive performances. Matt Liberatore of the St. Louis Cardinals threw six innings without giving up a run, striking out seven batters. Gavin Williams of the Cleveland Guardians tossed 5.2 innings, striking out 10 batters in a 5-0 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks. Jacob Misiorowski of the Los Angeles Angels pitched seven innings, striking out 10 batters in a 3-0 win over the Milwaukee Brewers.

Other notable performances came from Jose Caballero, who hit a home run and drove in two runs for the New York Yankees in their 2-1 win over the Chicago Cubs. Mike Yastrzemski hit a home run and drove in two runs for the Washington Nationals in their 2-4 loss to the Atlanta Braves.
